title: Shopping at Cabot Circus
subtitle: Repaso para el examen A2: phrasal verbs, cantidades y past simple

content.instructions: Escribe la palabra que falta. Si hay una palabra entre paréntesis, úsala en la forma correcta.

items.text: On Saturday morning Lucía ___ (get up) early because she ___ (need) a winter coat. Her old jacket was ___ thin for the Bristol winter. She ___ (put on) a jumper and ___ (go out) with Priya. It ___ (be) freezing outside.
items.hint: Get → got, put → put, go → went. Too + adjetivo: demasiado.

items.text: Cabot Circus was very busy. There were a ___ of people everywhere. They ___ (look for) a coat for two hours. "There are ___ many shops here!" Lucía said. "I ___ (not / know) where to start." The bus home ___ (be) at five, so they had to be quick.
items.hint: A lot of + plural o incontable. Too many + plural.

items.text: In the fitting room, Lucía ___ (try on) a red coat, a black coat and a green coat. The black one had a hood, but the sleeves ___ (be) too long. The red one wasn't big ___. She liked the green one, so she ___ (try / it / on) again.
items.hint: Enough va detrás del adjetivo: big enough. Con pronombre, en medio: tried it on.
items.explanation: Try on es separable: con un pronombre (it, them) este va en medio, tried it on, nunca «tried on it».

items.text: "How ___ is it?" Lucía asked the shop assistant. "It's only forty pounds." What a bargain! Lucía ___ (pay) by card. "Is this bag ___ (you)?" the shop assistant asked. "No, it's ___ (Priya)."
items.hint: Precio: how much. Pay → paid. Posesivos: yours, y 's para personas.

items.text: Then they ___ (sit down) in a café. ___ of them were hungry, so they ordered two big pieces of cake. "How ___ sugar do you want in your tea?" Priya asked. "Just a ___, please." Lucía's phone rang, but she didn't ___ (pick / it / up) because her hands were full of bags. It was Javi.
items.hint: Both: los dos. Sugar es incontable: how much, a little.

items.text: At five o'clock they ___ (find out) that the café was closing, so they ___ (go back) home. The bus ___ (be) full of people with shopping bags. When she lived in Valencia, Lucía ___ (use to / wear) a thin jacket all winter!
items.hint: Find → found. Hábito del pasado: used to + verbo.

items.text: At home, Lucía ___ (call / him / back) and told him about the coat. "I ___ (wear) it right now!" she said. "Green? Really?" Javi laughed. "You ___ (never / wear) green! You ___ (always / say) it's ugly!"
items.hint: Ahora mismo: present continuous. Costumbre: present simple con never / always.

vocabulary.definition: a small room in a shop where you try on clothes
the part of a coat that covers your head
the part of a coat or shirt that covers your arm
something that costs much less than usual
